parameters.name: AppId
parameters.description: The ID of the interactive message application.

parameters.name: GroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the message group.

parameters.name: OperatorUserId
parameters.description: The user ID of the operator. This user must be the creator of the group.

parameters.name: PageNum
parameters.description: The page number. Default value: 1. Valid values: 1 to 100000.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of users to display on each page. Default value: 20. Valid values: 1 to 50.
